name: Wall shin-angle holds
cue_language: Load the front shin. Push the wall away, don't stand up.

name: Push-step med ball starts
cue_language: Finish the first push before you chase step two.

name: Low-heel acceleration marches
cue_language: Hips stay behind the drive line for three contacts.

name: Approach-step cuts
cue_language: Shorten the last step. Drop the hip, don't lean the torso.

name: Ankle-stiff pogos to first step
cue_language: Quiet contact. Get off the ground.
